messages: maria_ae: FYI Lumina Insights just sent an escalation — they want a formal SLA (99.9% for inference) + a private deployment in our EU region, requested delivery by May 15. asking for committed throughput for embeddings and chat.
maria_ae: theyre the biggest prospect in our Q2 pipeline, leaning enterprise. their legal team needs dates to sign the MSA.
alison_pm: thanks. two quick clarifying Qs: 1) is the 99.9% per-request latency SLO or uptime for the service endpoint? 2) do they need model pinning & reproducible versioning (no implicit upgrades)?

maria_ae: notes from call — they want endpoint availability 99.9% (routing + model availability). yes to model pinning, plus ability to fallback to a smaller model if primary is down. also need audit logs and KMS integration.

raj_eng: technically doable but delivery depends on a couple blockers: private control plane onboarding (networking + KMS) and dedicated GPU capacity in eu-west. model pinning & rollback path is mostly product work (namespaces + pinned_versions).

raj_eng: estimate rough timeline: 4w to enable pinned model routes + canary rollout support; 3w for KMS & audit hooks (assuming infra work starts asap); GPU procurement / capacity commit could be 6+ weeks unless we use burst on Hosted Dedicated.

tom_sre: +1. eu-west capacity is constrained this quarter. we can offer Reserved Dedicated pool but it requires a capacity commit and billing change. alternative: multi-region fallback to us-west until dedicated is available, but that affects latency.

sam_sec: security review flagged: VPC peering + customer-managed keys require our new onboarding checklist. expect ~2-3 weeks for a prioritised review, longer if they request HSM attestation. also need to confirm data residency controls.
maria_ae: they absolutely need EU data residency and KMS in their tenant. HSM not mandatory but theyll ask in legal. they want the go/no-go decision by next Thursday at the latest.

alison_pm: proposed scoping to get them to Yes fast: Phase 1 (MVP): private control plane + KMS integration + model pinning + audit logs + canary rollback. Phase 2: dedicated reserved GPUs and extended SLAs after commit. Acceptance criteria: playbook for failover, demo runbook, and perf numbers for 512-token chat.

raj_eng: agree. for Phase 1 we can implement pinned_routes and audit events in 3w if we allocate 2 devs (backend + infra). canary rollback needs a lightweight routing flag and tests. I'll draft a minimal spec.

tom_sre: I'll check capacity options with ops and see if we can carve a short-term dedicated pool for them under a monthly commit. if not, recommend staged SLA: 99.9% for control plane + 99.5% for inference until dedicated capacity is live.
sam_sec: I'll fast-track the security checklist and start the review assuming we get the architecture doc today. will ping infra owners for KMS scoping.
deploy-bot: Deployment window availability (eu-west): May 2-6, May 16-20, June 1-5. Use `./deploy schedule --region=eu-west --windows` to reserve.

alison_pm: next actions: Raj to share spec by EOD tomorrow; Tom to confirm capacity options by Mon; Sam to start security review and list docs needed; Maria to push Lumina for flexibility on May 15 vs May 30. I'll prepare a one-pager for legal.
maria_ae: noted. I'll try to move their target to May 30. will send follow-up and cc product and security. :crossed_fingers:

raj_eng: spec link (draft): ```
routes:
  - name: lumina-primary
    model: rw-llama-70b-q8
    pinned_version: v2.1.0
    fallback: lumina-fallback
audit:
  enabled: true
  sink: customer-kms
canary:
  percentage: 10
  metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate]
```  more details in the RFC I'll upload.
alison_pm: perfect. once Raj posts RFC we'll run a quick triage and mark must-have vs nice-to-have. goal: ship Phase 1 in 3 weeks if capacity confirmed.
maria_ae: thanks all — booking a contract sync with Lumina for Wed to align on the phased delivery and signoff criteria. I'll share minutes after the call.
tom_sre: FYI if we go with the staged SLA we'll need to update our pricing sheet and the Dedicated contract template. cc @legal (will loop in).
sam_sec: I'll add the required checklist items to the thread once we have the RFC. expected blockers: network ACLs, KMS key policy, and retention settings for audit logs.
alison_pm: OK — closing the loop here. Raj, Tom, Sam, please add blocking tickets to the product board and tag them `lumina-sla` before EOD tomorrow.
maria_ae: Lumina sync scheduled. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
